candidates.description: This vector represents common English verbs that frequently take prepositional objects or complement clauses.
This vector represents adverbial and nominal suffixes, primarily forming adverbs and nouns related to manner, state, or action in Romance languages like Spanish, Portuguese, and Italian.
This feature activates on the names of prominent Western philosophers, literary figures, and intellectuals.
This feature vector activates strongly in response to common European male given names.
This vector represents traditional male given names of English origin, commonly popular in the 19th and early 20th centuries.
This vector represents common Portuguese vocabulary words spanning various parts of speech.
This feature activates on common linguistic subwords and suffixes frequently occurring across multiple European languages.
This vector activates on word fragments and roots containing the letter sequence "pl" or "empl" associated with exemplification, explanation, and demonstration.
This feature activates on common word-final and name-ending strings containing the letters 'r' and 'e'.
This feature vector activates on tokens and subwords related to possibility, necessity, and their linguistic prefixes or roots.
